repos_data.description: Typed TypeScript SDK for direct and managed social platform integrations, with capability checks, explicit outcomes, and deterministic testing.

MCP server to publish to Dev.to, Ghost, Hashnode, WordPress, Medium, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Mastodon from Claude Code. SEO scoring, canonical-URL wiring, social-post generation, Unsplash covers, IndexNow.
Multi-channel content distribution MCP server with idempotent state. Auto-publish to DEV.to, Hashnode, GitHub Discussions, Reddit, Bluesky; browser-fallback for Medium, LinkedIn, X/Twitter.
The best free social media publishing and scheduling API. SDKs for Python & Node, MCP server for AI agents, 15 platforms.
Check a social post against a platform's real character limits over MCP. Graphemes, t.co URL weighting, and CJK/Hangul/emoji double-counting -- the things an LLM cannot count by inspection.
